summary: Aisle runners come 36, 40, 48 or 60 in wide; 36 in fits two people side by side. Length comes from the chair rows: about 36 in per row, plus 6 to 8 ft at the front and 2 ft at the back. Woven polyester, velvet, burlap or low-pile carpet.
